  - Wii release dates: Japan 2009-01-29, North America 2009-03-24, Europe 2009-03-27; publisher Square Enix
- https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/ファイナルファンタジー・クリスタルクロニクル_エコーズ・オブ・タイム -- dates*, platforms*, players -- accessed 2026-10-25 (page text pasted by user)
  - Action RPG for Nintendo DS and Wii, released together on 2009-01-29 (Japan); 1 to 4 players; developer and publisher Square Enix; the fourth Crystal Chronicles game and the sequel to Ring of Fates
  - The first title to let a DS and a Wii play one game together over Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection or wireless; DS-to-DS wireless play too
  - The Wii version uses the Wii Remote and Nunchuk and does not support the Classic Controller or the GameCube controller
  - Also sold in Japan as a Nintendo DSi bundle (Crystal Chronicles Edition)
  - External link: https://www.jp.square-enix.com/game/detail/ffcc_eot/ (the live page is script-rendered; its fetched HTML holds only the site menu)
- https://www.jp.square-enix.com/game/detail/ffcc_eot/ -- the official Japanese game detail page; profileUrl*, dates*, platforms* -- accessed 2026-10-25 (page text pasted by user)
  - https://web.archive.org/web/20191115075343/https://www.jp.square-enix.com/game/detail/ffcc_eot/ -- capture of 2019-11-15 (8 captures, 2019-11-15 to 2025-11-07; only this one and the capture of 2025-08-08 read)
  - https://web.archive.org/web/20250808015203/https://www.jp.square-enix.com/game/detail/ffcc_eot/ -- last working capture, 2025-08-08; the same content as 2019 (the pasted text ends inside the DS row, which shows its 2009.01.29 date)
  - Action RPG, 1 player (1 to 4); Wii release 2009.01.29, CERO A; Nintendo DS / DSi release 2009.01.29, CERO A; each with a Square Enix e-STORE purchase link (Wii http://store.jp.square-enix.com/item/RVL_P_RFFJ.html, DS http://store.jp.square-enix.com/item/NTR_P_CFIJ.html, capture of 2021-01-29)
  - Notice: with the end of the Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection service, the in-game multiplayer that used it ended on 2014-05-20; multiplayer over DS wireless communication still works

## Decisions
